description: Source code for a Windows-specific utility that inspects PE files to list their dependencies (DLLs). It includes functions to load libraries, retrieve import descriptors, and print dependencies, with licensing information and main execution logic.

methods.name: getLastErrorString
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message as a string.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes a loaded module to extract its import dependencies (DLLs).

methods.name: printDependencies
methods.description: Loads a library and prints its dependencies.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command-line arguments and invokes dependency printing.
